patch.content:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

menu "C Library"

source "lib/libc/minimal/Kconfig"
source "lib/libc/picolibc/Kconfig"
source "lib/libc/newlib/Kconfig"

choice
	prompt "C library"
	default MINIMAL_LIBC
	help
	  Select the C library implementation to use.

config MINIMAL_LIBC
	bool "Minimal C library"
	select LIBC_MINIMAL
	help
	  This option enables the minimal C library. This library
	  provides a basic set of C library APIs.

config PICOLIBC
	bool "Picolibc C library"
	select PICOLIBC_SUPPORT
	select SYS_LIBC_HAS_REENT
	help
	  This option enables the Picolibc C library.

config NEWLIB_LIBC
	bool "Newlib C library"
	select NEWLIB_LIBC_SUPPORT
	select SYS_LIBC_HAS_REENT
	help
	  This option enables the Newlib C library.

config EXTERNAL_LIBC
	bool "External C library"
	help
	  This option indicates that an external C library is used.
	  This is automatically selected by toolchains that provide
	  their own C library.

endchoice

config LIBC_MINIMAL
	bool

config PICOLIBC_SUPPORT
	bool

config NEWLIB_LIBC_SUPPORT
	bool

config HAS_LIBC_PLUSPLUS
	bool "C++ library"
	depends on CPLUSPLUS
	help
	  Enable C++ support.

config CPLUSPLUS
	bool

config SYS_LIBC_HAS_REENT
	bool

config MALLOC_ALIGNMENT
	int
	default 8 if 64BIT
	default 4

config STACK_CANARIES
	bool "Compiler stack canaries"
	depends on TOOLCHAIN_HAS_STACK_CANARIES
	help
	  Enable compiler-generated stack canaries to detect stack
	  overflows. When a stack overflow is detected, the kernel
	  will treat it as a fatal error.

config LIBC_ERRNO
	bool "Use libc's errno"
	default y if NEWLIB_LIBC || PICOLIBC
	help
	  Use the C library's errno implementation instead of Zephyr's
	  thread-local implementation. This is required for C libraries
	  that are re-entrant.

config PRINTK
	bool "Enable printk"
	default y
	help
	  This option enables the printk() API, which is a non-standard
	  and simplified version of the standard printf() function.
	  It is used to print formatted strings to the console.

config EARLY_CONSOLE
	bool "Enable early console"
	depends on PRINTK
	help
	  Enable console before kernel is fully initialized.

config STDOUT_CONSOLE
	bool "Redirect stdout to console"
	default y if !(NATIVE_LIBRARY && EXTERNAL_LIBC)
	depends on CONSOLE
	depends on !(NATIVE_LIBRARY && EXTERNAL_LIBC)
	help
	  Redirect stdout to the console device. This makes functions
	  like printf() output to the system console.

endmenu
